description: This Java source file defines the static factory class 'ThingAcknowledgementsFactory' which provides methods for creating and parsing 'Acknowledgements' related to 'Thing' entities within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for constructing acknowledgements with specific parameters and deserializing acknowledgements from JSON.

classes.name: ThingAcknowledgementsFactory
classes.description: A final utility class providing factory methods for creating 'Acknowledgements' instances related to 'Thing' entities within the Eclipse Ditto framework.
